title: Fulfilment composition
description: Offered fulfilment options for this order. Multi-valued across three orthogonal dimensions: modalities (consume-onsite / pickup / delivery / virtual), courier coordinations (meaningful only when delivery is among the modalities), and handoff points (where physical exchange occurs). A merchant declares the set of options on offer at template time; at runtime a buyer's commitment carries the same shape with single-element arrays reflecting their choice. Every order has a fulfilment clause — even fully-virtual products carry modalities: ['virtual']. Proximity verification of the handoff event lives in figaro-proximity-policy-v1, not here.

fields.name: modalities
fields.description: Top-level fulfilment modalities on offer. consume-onsite = on-premise consumption. pickup = buyer collects from seller's premises. delivery = transported to the buyer. virtual = digital / online / no physical fulfilment. At least one must be set.

fields.name: coordinations
fields.description: Courier-coordination options on offer. Meaningful only when 'delivery' is among the modalities; the validator rejects non-empty coordinations when delivery is not offered, and requires non-empty coordinations when delivery is offered.

fields.name: handoffPoints
fields.description: Handoff points on offer. Cryptographic proof of proximity at the handoff event belongs in figaro-proximity-policy-v1, not here.
